tongya.name: Tongya Heavy Industry
tongya.description: Founded in 2003 with 20+ years of trailer manufacturing excellence. Equipped with intelligent robotic welding lines and electrophoretic coating processes. Specializing in container trailers, aluminum tankers, powder tankers, and bulk cement trailers for African markets.

huayu.name: Huayu Group
huayu.description: A Liangshan-based trailer manufacturing powerhouse with decades of experience. Specializing in flatbed semi-trailers, dump trailers, lowbed trailers, and bulk cargo trailers. Known for heavy-duty construction, competitive pricing, and high-volume export capability to Africa.
